title: My First Blog Post
description: The first post on my personal blog, documenting the process of building the site and the ideas behind it.

strings.终于有了一个属于自己的个人空间。: I finally have a personal space of my own.
strings.相比社交平台，我更希望这里能安静地记录一些完整的想法， 不必追逐热点，也不必在意: Unlike social media, I want this to be a quiet place where I can record complete thoughts—without chasing trends or worrying about how many people read each post.
strings.写作让我有机会重新整理自己的思路。: Writing gives me a chance to organize my thoughts and see them more clearly.
strings.技术、生活、读书，或者一些暂时没有答案的问题， 都可以成为值得记录的内容。: Technology, everyday life, books, and even questions that do not yet have answers can all be worth writing about.
strings.以后就慢慢更新吧。: I’ll keep adding to this blog at my own pace.
